tools.name: assetfare_status
tools.description: Read current capabilities, caps, pause state, and independent RPC quorum.

tools.name: assetfare_manifest
tools.description: Read the Ed25519-signed capability, contract, release, and mainnet-evidence manifest.

tools.name: assetfare_quote
tools.description: Get a fee-inclusive Solana SOL to Base or Arbitrum ETH quote. This does not create a session or transaction.

tools.name: assetfare_start_wallet_auth
tools.description: Create a non-transactional Solana signMessage challenge. Requires caller approval because it creates a short-lived login challenge; it cannot move funds.

tools.name: assetfare_finish_wallet_auth
tools.description: Verify a wallet signature over the exact challenge message and return a wallet-bound access token. Requires caller approval; the returned token is sensitive.

tools.name: assetfare_create_session
tools.description: Lock a fresh quote into a wallet-bound execution session. This creates no transaction, but reserves the caller's one active session slot.

tools.name: assetfare_read_session
tools.description: Read a wallet-bound session, workflow, receipt, or current unsigned action. Read-only.

tools.name: assetfare_prepare_source_action
tools.description: Prepare a bounded unsigned Solana source action. Requires caller approval; it never signs or submits.

tools.name: assetfare_verify_source_receipt
tools.description: Verify a caller-submitted finalized Solana source signature and advance the workflow. Requires caller approval; it never submits a transaction.

tools.name: assetfare_prepare_cctp_action
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned CCTP burn action using a caller-generated event signer public key. Requires caller approval; it never signs or submits.

tools.name: assetfare_observe_cctp
tools.description: Verify Circle attestation and the forwarded Base or Arbitrum USDC mint for an already-submitted burn. Read-only on chain, but advances the session record.

tools.name: assetfare_prepare_destination_action
tools.description: Prepare the exact-cap permit and unsigned ERC-4337 destination settlement plan. Requires caller approval; it never signs or submits.

tools.name: assetfare_observe_destination
tools.description: Verify an already-submitted destination UserOperation receipt and finalize the workflow. Requires caller approval; it never submits a transaction.
